$comment: Derived from the actual React source in src/ (pages, components, styles) cross-checked against the Playwright-measured specs on disk: CLONE_SPEC.md and spec/SPEC_*.md. Section order within each template is real DOM order as rendered, not inferred from design intent.

meta.source: https://withotter.com/ — pixel-audited React 18 + Vite + Tailwind v3 clone of the live site
meta.mirror: reference/original.html + reference/assets/with-otter-*.shared.34930fed5.min.css (saved homepage DOM and compiled Webflow stylesheet, byte-identical across every marketing route)
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill, from the clone's own components after three independent pixel-audit passes

categories.CHROME: Shared wrapper present on every marketing route: navigation, footer, and the SVG clip-path definitions the organic shapes reference.
categories.HERO: Page-opening header block, above or at the start of the main content.
categories.EXPLAIN: Product explanation: how the service works, capability tabs, programme status.
categories.PROOF: Social proof and reassurance: press logos, testimonials, trust cards, video.
categories.CONTENT: The substantive body content of a route — prose, collections, article text.
categories.CONVERT: Blocks whose job is to get the visitor to act: CTA cards and bands, the contact form.
categories.RECRUIT: Careers-only blocks: the market-gap argument, values, benefits, compensation, open roles.
categories.AUTH: Blocks belonging to the app host's own design system, not the marketing one.

chrome.nav.description: Non-sticky top navigation: wordmark, four primary links with an organic blob current-indicator, and log-in / sign-up actions. Ships two variants — the homepage renders an empty primary-link container, every other marketing route populates it.
chrome.nav.scope: Present on all 20 marketing routes; absent from the log-in screen, which has no marketing chrome.

chrome.footer.description: Two-card footer: a dark primary sign-up card and a white card, above a link region and a legal/copyright row. Like the nav, the homepage ships an empty link container while other routes populate three columns.
chrome.footer.scope: Present on all 20 marketing routes; absent from the log-in screen.

chrome.shape-defs.description: Invisible SVG defs block holding the seven objectBoundingBox clip paths that every organic stone and blob references by id. Renders nothing itself; no route adds new path data.
chrome.shape-defs.scope: Mounted once per page on all 20 marketing routes; not used by the log-in screen.

hero.home.description: Homepage hero: large display headline, supporting copy, a single CTA, and a 72px-radius image container flanked by five clipped stone shapes.

hero.page.description: Shared audience-page hero: copy column plus a shape container carrying two clipped stones, with per-route fills and a per-route photo. Parametrised by props rather than duplicated.
hero.page.scope: The 3 audience pages: parents, sitters, trust-safety.

hero.centered-title.description: Simple centred page header — eyebrow plus display heading in a narrow container, with no image. Structurally the same block on each route but currently written inline in all three pages rather than extracted.
hero.centered-title.scope: 3 routes: faq, contact, careers. A reuse candidate — see README.

hero.blog-index.description: Blog index header: display heading beside a full-bleed hero illustration, in a zero-padding section.

hero.post.description: Article header: title, one to three tag pills, and a 1:1 cover image at 32px radius. Deliberately carries no author, date, read-time, share or breadcrumb slot — the original has none.

hero.legal-title.description: Legal document title band — eyebrow plus document title, rendered outside the main content element as on the original.
hero.legal-title.scope: The 2 legal routes: terms-of-use and privacy-policy.

explain.beta-banner.description: Programme-status banner announcing beta availability and free access, with a sign-up CTA.

explain.how-it-works.description: Section header plus three numbered steps on organic bullet backgrounds. Carries the site's only scroll-reveal animation, on its section header.

explain.join-card.description: Large full-width card with a background illustration, growth-oriented copy and a primary join action. Rendered at the tail of the how-it-works section.

explain.tabs.description: Dual-mode capability explainer: a pill tab strip with an absolutely-positioned card above 991px, which becomes a CSS-sibling-driven accordion at or below it. Open and close timings are deliberately asymmetric.

proof.press-bar.description: Press bar on a peach 40px-radius panel carrying four third-party publication logos. These are real external trademarks — see the licensing note in the README.

proof.testimonials.description: Testimonial slider with heading, lede and two circular arrow controls. The underlying CMS collection is empty on the original, so it renders a grey 'No items found.' empty state — intentional, not missing content.

proof.common-questions.description: 'Common questions' heading above an empty CMS collection list. Renders the same deliberate grey empty state; there is no accordion behind it on the original.

proof.video-facade.description: Click-to-play video facade: poster image and play button in a ~16:9 ivory box. The third-party player iframe is injected only after a user click, so page load makes no cross-origin request.

proof.trust-cards.description: Two rows of two white trust cards, each with an icon, heading and body, covering vetting and care standards.

content.faq-category-rows.description: Two static audience category rows ('For parents', 'For sitters'), each pairing a heading with an empty CMS collection list. Because both collections are empty on the original, this route carries no actual question-and-answer content.

content.post-grid.description: Collection grid: one featured post in a 50/50 row, then a three-up grid of standard cards. Both card variants are 4:3, and neither has any hover state or transition on the original.

content.load-more.description: Pagination pill reproducing the original's Finsweet load-more control. Deliberately inert in the clone — the original's collection holds more posts than the ten rebuilt here, so there is no further page to load.

content.rich-text.description: Article body prose block. Base 16/24 weight-500 body type at every breakpoint, with a flat 4rem heading top-margin that does not shrink on mobile. Article bodies in this clone are placeholder prose, not the original articles.

content.related-posts.description: 'Similar articles' row of three post cards in the wide container, reusing the standard card. Selection is next-in-collection-order here, because the original draws from posts outside the rebuilt set.

content.legal-prose.description: Hand-authored legal document body: a repeating rule-plus-heading-plus-paragraph pattern in the wide container, giving a wider measure than the article prose block. Lists are faked with line breaks exactly as the original does.
content.legal-prose.scope: The 2 legal routes. Holds real operative legal copy — see the README licensing note.

convert.cta-card.description: Large conversion card pairing an illustration with a heading and a sign-up action, in a wide or extra-wide variant depending on route.

convert.cta-band.description: Horizontal conversion band with heading, supporting copy, an action and a supporting image.

convert.contact-form.description: Five-field contact form with a screen-reader heading, plus custom success and failure blocks. Submits locally only — no endpoint and no network request — and carries no error styling, because the original defines none.

convert.contact-info.description: Supporting contact column: icon-led email and postal-address blocks beside the form.

recruit.gap-intro.description: Narrative block introducing the childcare-market gap the company positions against, with supporting imagery.

recruit.gap-stats.description: Centred heading above a six-up responsive grid of statistic blocks, each an eyebrow, a large figure and a caption.

recruit.values.description: Operating-principles grid: six value cards with 72px icons, behind a screen-reader-only heading. Uses the full-width container rather than the narrow one.

recruit.benefits.description: Centred header plus a grid of six benefit items with 88px icons.

recruit.compensation.description: Centred header plus prose setting out the company's compensation philosophy.

recruit.positions.description: Open-roles list at an anchor target. Each row reuses the accordion item markup as a link pill out to the external applicant-tracking system, with a hover inversion that deliberately excludes its icon pill.

auth.login-form.description: Log-in screen: wordmark, illustration, heading and a single phone-number field with a floating label, on a flat background with no card. Built from the app host's own design system, and deliberately inert — no action, no endpoint, autocomplete disabled, submit cancelled.
auth.login-form.scope: Log-in only — 1 route, the single route using the app host's design system.

content.not-found-stub.description: Placeholder body for the catch-all route: a single line of scaffold text in a plain section. The original site's 404 page was never visited or measured, so no real layout is documented. Not a copy of anything on withotter.com.
content.not-found-stub.scope: Catch-all fallback only — matches no named route, so it carries 0 of the 21 routes.
